explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list; FDA's record shows actions at plants on our labels

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include argatroban as of 2026-10-21.
Both Corvale East and Corvale General stock argatroban 50 mg/50 mL vials labeled by Eugia US LLC with NDC 55150024101.
The product label identifies the manufacturing plant as Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) in India.
FDA inspected that plant on 2026-02-06 and classified it OAI; the classification was posted on 2026-09-21.
An earlier OAI inspection ended 2024-02-02 with a Warning Letter issued 2024-08-15.
Alternate manufacturers Accord Healthcare Inc. and Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC are not on the shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place.
